message.content: {"note_claim": "Troy Lake was convicted for removing/disabling emissions controls on diesel trucks at his repair business, not for fixing his own vehicle, and did not get 7 years.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Troy Lake, a 65-year-old diesel mechanic, spent seven months in federal prison for “conspiracy to violate the Clean Air Act.”", "reason": "The page confirms Lake was a diesel mechanic convicted of conspiracy to violate the Clean Air Act by removing emission controls and served about seven months, consistent with not 7 years, but it does not state the 12 months and 1 day sentence, the hundreds of commercial trucks, or the repair business."}

parsed.note_claim: Troy Lake was convicted for removing/disabling emissions controls on diesel trucks at his repair business, not for fixing his own vehicle, and did not get 7 years.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Troy Lake, a 65-year-old diesel mechanic, spent seven months in federal prison for “conspiracy to violate the Clean Air Act.”
parsed.reason: The page confirms Lake was a diesel mechanic convicted of conspiracy to violate the Clean Air Act by removing emission controls and served about seven months, consistent with not 7 years, but it does not state the 12 months and 1 day sentence, the hundreds of commercial trucks, or the repair business.
